description: Encode text (as UTF-8) or a file (path or base64) to Base64. Options: URL-safe alphabet (- and _, no padding), wrap at 76 columns (MIME), or a data: URI for files (MIME type detected from magic bytes). Results over 1 MB, or when "output" is given, are written to a text file instead of returned inline. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/base64-kit/

dataUri.description: Return a data: URI (data:<mime>;base64,…) instead of bare Base64.

file.description: Or: a file to encode: local path or base64 data.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

urlSafe.description: Use the URL-safe alphabet (- and _) and drop "=" padding.

wrap.description: Insert a line break every 76 characters (MIME style).

name: base64_encode
title: Base64 encode
